semantics.required_rule: Required dependencies must resolve in the active graph.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional dependencies are explicit and may remain absent.
semantics.boot_rule: Missing runtime capability dependencies hard-fail when required; they are never silently auto-enabled.
semantics.ownership_rule: Depending on a semantic owner does not transfer ownership.
semantics.ordering_rule: Dependency does not automatically define execution order unless an owning causal contract says so.
semantics.cycle_rule: Dependency cycles are validated according to the owning dependency semantics and cannot be silently broken.

invariants.rule: Structural dimensions and registries remain explicit and are never collapsed into generic hierarchy.
